title: Credit and Collections Guideline: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Restore Target After Repeated Disconnections
content:
**Guideline.** For the restore payment of PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering), where the enrollment was disconnected for low balance at least twice in the one-month window and its low-balance alert amount is above the reconnect threshold, the restore target is the low-balance alert amount; where it was disconnected at least twice in that window and its alert amount is at or below the reconnect threshold, the restore target is the reconnect threshold plus 10.00; an enrollment in any other situation keeps the reconnect threshold.

The disconnections are counted by the disconnected alerts on the enrollment's PrePay notifications, and the alert amount is the enrollment's low-balance alert amount at the time of the quote. A window of a stated number of months takes the records dated after the same day of the month that many months before the current date, through the current date.

**Reconnect thresholds by tier.** 10.00 on PrePay Power Residential, PrePay Power Residential Recovery 25, PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40 and PrePay Power Outbuilding; 20.00 on PrePay Power Seasonal; 50.00 on PrePay Power Small Commercial.

**Condition — judgement — result (hypothetical enrollments on PrePay Power Seasonal, threshold 20.00)**

| Disconnections in the one-month window | Alert amount | Restore target |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 25.00 | 25.00, the alert amount, being above 20.00 |
| 3 | 20.00 | 30.00, the threshold plus 10.00, the alert amount being at the threshold |
| 2 | 15.00 | 30.00 |
| 1 | 25.00 | keeps the reconnect threshold of 20.00 |

On PrePay Power Small Commercial, two disconnections and an alert amount of 75.00 give a restore target of 75.00, being above 50.00.
